name: Foundations and piling
principle: Foundations transfer structural loads to the ground safely and within settlement limits. Shallow footings serve competent soils; driven or bored piles take loads past weak layers; ground improvement (stone columns, deep soil mixing, preloading) treats marginal ground instead of deep foundations. Site investigation drives everything — boreholes, SPT/CPT profiles, groundwater — and equipment foundations add dynamic checks for machines, plus settlement and vibration limits.

process_steps.name: Geotechnical investigation characterises strata and groundwater
Foundation type chosen: shallow, deep or ground improvement
Piles driven or bored, footings cast, ground improved
Load or integrity tests verify capacity

limitations: settlement of large tanks and racks on soft ground takes years to manifest; monitoring is part of design
driving vibration and noise constrain work near existing plant
advantages: mature, testable technology with local contractors nearly everywhere
ground improvement often beats deep foundations on cost for marginal soils
